description_expanded: OverviewPrivate Pool-Gulf Views-Golf Cart Rental Option- 2 Minute Walk- 5 Bikes `Miss Margaritaville`The Space Miss Margaritaville | Ultimate 30A Retreat QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Private Pool w/ Heat Option – Enjoy your own backyard oasis Two Spacious Living Areas – Perfect for large groups & families Gas Grill & Outdoor Kitchen – Ideal for BBQ nights 5 FREE Bikes Included – Cruise the scenic 30A 6-Seater Golf Cart Rental Option – Explore in style! Oversized Screened Porch – Ultimate relaxation space Multiple Balconies w/ Gulf Views – Stunning sunsets guaranteed Sleeps 16 | 5 Bedrooms – Room for the whole crew! Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected Driveway Parking for 6 Vehicles Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Hassle-free vacationingWelcome to Miss MargaritavilleMiss Margaritaville is a well laid out, beautifully remodeled, relaxing vacation home on 30A. This beautiful and classic Florida home is the perfect place to enjoy your family time any time of the year. Miss Margaritaville has been renovated (2020) with new exterior siding, doors, paint, new Flat screen TV`s, beds, sofa, screen porch and landscaping. Located right on beautiful 30A in the Seacrest community, Miss Margaritaville is just minutes from SEASIDE, ALYS BEACH and ROSEMARY BEACH.With 5 Bedrooms and sleeping for 16 there is plenty of room. Just out the back is a BEAUTIFUL POOL with plenty of deck and patio space to enjoy. You may not even care to go to the beach! The back yard is fenced for safety and protection. Just off the pool deck is a living area with dining table and HD TV. Plus, plenty of loungers surrounding the pool.As you walk up the stairs from the pool you enter the massive and beautifully decorated screen porch overlooking the pool. You may not leave this space your entire trip. It has everything you need.Living area with sectional sofa and HD TV. Dining Area just behind the sofa and a large kitchen area with gas grill, full-size stainless-steel refrigerator, and sink!As you walk into the main level from the screen porch is the kitchen area, leading to the dining room. The dining room features 2 tables with seating for 14. Just off the dining area is the spacious living room with sectionals sofa and 2 chairs. The oversized front porch is off the living room. The main level features a beautifully designed full bathroom with full size laundry. Just off this bathroom is a king size bedroom.From the main level moving up to the third floor are 2 bedrooms separated by a bathroom. The first bedroom to the left is a bunk room with 2 full size beds and 2 twin beds. The bedroom to the right is a king size bedroom with private balcony with Gulf views and amazing sunsets.From the main level going down to the first floor are an additional 2 bedrooms, bathroom, and another washer/dryer. The first bedroom is a huge King size suite. The second bedroom is a bunkroom with 2 twin over twin beds. There are also 2 HD TV`s in this room. One for watching DirecTV and the other for hooking up to a gaming unit or other device. There are 2 beach accesses in equal distance to the east and to the west. Take your pick which way to go each day and enjoy all 30A has to offer!Visit MISS MARGARITAVILLE on your trip to the beautiful white sands near SEACREST BEACH and it will become your family tradition for years to come.There are two beach accesses within 170 yards from the home in either direction!! However, if you would like to reserve beach chairs the closest beach access is located at Walton Dunes, about 3.4 miles west of 30A. The two closest beach accesses do not allow for public vending.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Pool Heat* Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st* Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay* Pool heat is not guaranteedSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (16):Main Level Bedroom: King sized bed, shared bathroomFirst Floor Bedroom: King BedroomFirst Floor Bunkroom: 2 Twin over twin bunk bedsThird Floor Bedroom: King sized bed, shared bathroom with shower/tub comboThird Floor Bunk Room: 2 Full Beds and 2 Twin Beds, shared bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
